summary.name: Evernote
summary.one_liner: Evernote is a note-taking app for capturing, organizing, and syncing notes, tasks, and schedules across devices, with AI features added in v11.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Evernote as a place to capture notes, tasks, and schedules in one spot, organized with a flexible structure. It says notes are synced across all devices and can be surfaced quickly through search. Users can record, transcribe, scan, and clip content, which is stored in the app. Evernote v11 is said to add AI features, with standalone AI tools offered as a trial. Real-time editing, comments, and task assignment are listed for teamwork.
notable: Integrated tasks and schedules alongside notes
Record, transcribe, scan, and clip content
Real-time collaboration with comments and task assignment
caveats: Page mentions a free trial but does not specify plan limits or prices
Platforms are not named on the page text
Listing on awesome-mac marks it as freeware, but the page itself does not state the pricing model
